summary: This note is a short plot summary of the film Bridget Jones's Baby, given twice in slightly different wording. A year later, Bridget prepares to be married. At the altar, Jack greets her while holding her son, and she then marries Mark Darcy. Afterward, Mark and Jack, now friends, go to the reception together while Bridget carries her and Mark's son, William.
